correctness.rationale: Exact strong-support and closed-walk-gain criterion; unique normalized potential representation for every quotient cyclic group; subgroup Möbius inversion; and explicit directed-cut inclusion-exclusion prove all coefficients and extremal cases. The direct multiplication checker exhausts n=2, m=1 through 4, while lifted-path reachability independently enumerates all coefficients n=3,m=2. The proof, not finite checks, establishes the universal assertion.

originality.rationale: The inspected primary Rees/Brandt literature gives the minimum generator rank, while the new statement provides every subset-size coefficient for every cyclic group order and matrix index number. The gain-subgroup potential bijection combined with arithmetic Möbius inversion is a genuine all-size enumeration, not entailed by the minimum rank number. Related published records concern nilpotency of Brandt power-semigroup elements or idempotent generation of random Rees semigroups. An earlier implicit equivalent via gain graph reliability remains possible.
residual_risks: The 1987 Gomes-Howie primary full text was cited by the inspected sources but not accessible in full during this comparison.
An earlier general gain-graph or group-labeled-digraph generating reliability formula could implicitly contain this specialization.

value.rationale: Counting all generating subsets by size is a natural finite-semigroup reliability invariant, not just a rephrasing of minimum generating rank. The new formula covers unbounded group orders and matrix indices and captures the genuinely arithmetic cyclic gain obstruction via a divisor-Möbius transform. Its sharp Hamiltonian/totient multiplicity is an interpretable consequence of the full spectrum.
